title: Remove hardcoded CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY=true from docker-compose
description:
**Severity: HIGH**

**File**: `docker-compose.yml:136`

**Bug**: Dashboard always embeds the API key (hardcoded `true`). This is a security risk — the API key gets baked into the frontend bundle and is visible to any browser user.

**Fix**: Change to `${CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY:-false}` to default to secure behavior. Users who want the convenience can explicitly opt in via .env.
definitionOfDone: CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY defaults to false via env var substitution
Documented in .env.example with a security note

implementationPlan.description: Change hardcoded `CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY=true` on line 136 of docker-compose.yml to `CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY=${CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY:-false}` so it defaults to the secure behavior (not embedding the API key in the frontend bundle).

Update .env.example to uncomment `CORDUM_DASHBOARD_EMBED_API_KEY` and add a clear security warning: set to `true` only in development, never in production, as it embeds the API key in the frontend JavaScript bundle.
Run `docker compose config` to validate the compose file parses correctly with the new variable substitution syntax.
